LanguageData.VGE_TwistedSteel.label: twisted steel
LanguageData.VGE_TwistedSteel.description: The collapsed remains of an ancient orbital vessel, bent and fused by countless years in the harsh vacuum. Rich in steel.
LanguageData.VGE_TwistedSteel_Blueprint.label: twisted steel (blueprint)
LanguageData.VGE_TwistedSteel_Frame.label: twisted steel (building)
LanguageData.VGE_TwistedSteel_Frame.description: The collapsed remains of an ancient orbital vessel, bent and fused by countless years in the harsh vacuum. Rich in steel.
LanguageData.VGE_TwistedMachinery.label: twisted machinery
LanguageData.VGE_TwistedMachinery.description: Ancient machinery, compacted and twisted by centuries of impacts and extreme temperatures in orbit. Can be mined for useful components.
LanguageData.VGE_TwistedMachinery_Blueprint.label: twisted machinery (blueprint)
LanguageData.VGE_TwistedMachinery_Frame.label: twisted machinery (building)
LanguageData.VGE_TwistedMachinery_Frame.description: Ancient machinery, compacted and twisted by centuries of impacts and extreme temperatures in orbit. Can be mined for useful components.
LanguageData.VGE_TwistedElectronics.label: twisted electronics
LanguageData.VGE_TwistedElectronics.description: The fused remains of high-tech wiring and circuit boards, warped and damaged by orbital debris and temperature extremes. It can be salvaged for advanced components.
LanguageData.VGE_TwistedElectronics_Blueprint.label: twisted electronics (blueprint)
LanguageData.VGE_TwistedElectronics_Frame.label: twisted electronics (building)
LanguageData.VGE_TwistedElectronics_Frame.description: The fused remains of high-tech wiring and circuit boards, warped and damaged by orbital debris and temperature extremes. It can be salvaged for advanced components.
LanguageData.VGE_TwistedGravlite.label: twisted gravlite
LanguageData.VGE_TwistedGravlite.description: A section of warped and shattered gravlite paneling, barely recognizable after enduring intense orbital conditions. Can be salvaged for gravlite panels.
LanguageData.VGE_TwistedGravlite_Blueprint.label: twisted gravlite (blueprint)
LanguageData.VGE_TwistedGravlite_Frame.label: twisted gravlite (building)
LanguageData.VGE_TwistedGravlite_Frame.description: A section of warped and shattered gravlite paneling, barely recognizable after enduring intense orbital conditions. Can be salvaged for gravlite panels.
LanguageData.VGE_GravshipArmor.label: gravship armor
LanguageData.VGE_GravshipArmor.description: A heavily reinforced airtight wall designed to withstand extreme impacts and hostile fire in the vacuum of space. The wall connects directly into the underlying substructure, meaning it can only be built on a gravship.
